messages:
Asha: heads up — customer reported small but consistent extra token charges when a stream triggers a toolcall and the client reconnects mid-response. happens across a few accounts, low volume but reproducible. attaching quick repro below.

Devon: :thinking_face: can you paste the minimal repro and any server logs?

Asha: repro: start a streaming generation with `stream=true` and `session_id=abc123`, then after a few tokens simulate a network drop, reconnect with same `session_id`, the client sends the toolcall and we do a truncation+toolcall fallback. Billing shows the last chunk from before disconnect + a short suffix from after reconnect both billed instead of deduping. small snippet:```
# client (pseudo)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","stream":true,"session_id":"abc123","prompt":"..."}'
# drop connection after 120 tokens, reconnect and call tool
```

Ravi: thanks. my first guess: our coalesced ACK path is marking the session "provisional" tokens at reconnect then when the toolcall truncates the stream we confirm both fragments because the dedupe window is keyed by `session_id + last_ack_offset` and the reconnect resets offsets. could be an off-by-one in the ack offset we store.

Kim: do we have telemetry for per-chunk provisional vs confirmed billing? i want a quick query.

Devon: i ran a console query earlier today that looks relevant: ```sql
SELECT session_id, event_type, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM token_events
WHERE model = 'redwood-large' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY session_id, event_type
ORDER BY tokens desc
LIMIT 50;
```
It shows a handful of `provisional_charge` events followed shortly by `confirmed_charge` with overlapping token ranges for the same session_id.

Asha: attaching a tiny server log of one incident (masked):```
2026-03-18T15:01:02Z INFO stream_chunk session=abc123 offset=0 len=128 ack=0
2026-03-18T15:01:06Z INFO stream_chunk session=abc123 offset=128 len=64 ack=0
NETWORK DROP
2026-03-18T15:01:12Z INFO reconnect session=abc123 resume_offset=120
2026-03-18T15:01:13Z INFO toolcall trigger session=abc123 truncate_to=115
2026-03-18T15:01:13Z INFO provisional_charge session=abc123 range=0-128 tokens=128
2026-03-18T15:01:14Z INFO confirmed_charge session=abc123 range=0-115 tokens=115
```
Notice the provisional was for 0-128 then confirmed for 0-115, but the resumed response produced another provisional for the suffix which then also became confirmed in some traces.

Ravi: aha. the problem likely is we treat `confirmed_charge` as a separate commit without reconciling overlapping ranges. Instead of subtracting the overlap we mark both ranges billed. Should be a simple reconciliation step: when confirming, trim any earlier provisional ranges that overlap and only confirm the non-overlapping remainder.

Kim: is the overlap always at the end (suffix) or can it be interior? if toolcall truncates backwards we might have `truncate_to` < earlier ack offset which makes it trickier.

Asha: seen both but majority are suffix overlaps (resume produced small suffix). interior truncation is rarer but will happen with toolcall rewrites.

Devon: short-term mitigation: increase dedupe window to include resume_offset +/- 16 tokens so we avoid double-accepting tiny overlaps. long-term: reconcile token ranges on confirm. i'll open a cleanup PR.

Alex: UX note — customers see this as "mysterious fractional tokens" in console. we should add a column in the billing console for `provisional_tokens` and a tooltip linking to docs describing confirm lifecycle. also consider exposing a small audit trail per session_id (expandable) so support can show the ranges.

Asha: agree + file a support playbook. customers want visibility, not necessarily refunds when amounts are tiny but we need clarity.

ops-bot: canary deployed branch `fix/token-reconcile` to dev (region us-west-2) at 2026-03-18T16:05:00Z.

Ravi: PR #4321 opened with reconciliation and unit tests for overlapping ranges. still need a small migration for historical provisional events (or we handle them at query time).

Kim: i'll add a dashboard panel showing "provisional vs confirmed" deltas over time and an alert if overlap_rate > 0.1% of sessions. linking to draft: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/board/edgecase-provisional-confirmed

Asha: action items: 1) Devon/Ravi implement reconciliation + small dedupe window quick fix (PR 4321), 2) Kim add dashboard + alert, 3) Alex update billing console UX copy, 4) support playbook + canned reply. i'm on customer sync tomorrow morning.

Devon: will post production rollout plan + migration notes in the thread when ready.

Alex: thx everyone.

Asha: (added) filed internal ticket RDW-8272 for refund review for affected accounts; low priority but tracked.
